The Mission of

GOOD GARDENER

Clothing, Community & Good Gardeners of the World

Honor people who bring things to life.

That is the heart of Good Gardener. We celebrate people who care deeply about what they do, put in the work, and strive to be the best at it.

Make clothes.

Our clothing carries the Good Gardener idea into everyday life: dedication to your craft, care for others, and pride in doing good work.

Help the community.

Good work reaches beyond the person doing it. Our community purpose is to support people and celebrate the care they put into the world around them.

Give good work a place to be seen.

Through our monthly award, we tell the stories behind the work and recognize the people who make it possible.
